toast.stickyBody: Check again to see whether atlas restarted.
toast.longBody: The other realm has no room for a computer this size. Free a slot there, or choose a smaller plan, then try again. Nothing on atlas changed.
toast.huge: Couldn't restore atlas from its backup
toast.hugeBody: The backup from 03:00 is on a server that did not answer. Your computer atlas still runs from its own disk, and nothing on it changed. Its files, programs, schedules and addresses are as they were before you asked. You can try the restore again in a few minutes, or pick an older backup from the list, which is kept on another server. If the server stays silent, the backups it holds are copied to a new one within the hour and show again in the list. Restores never delete a backup. While a restore runs, atlas keeps answering on its addresses until the switch, which takes under a minute. When it finishes you get a note here and in your notifications.
